expectations.evidence: Rollback step 4 adds "If it still fails, escalate in #billing-oncall," an escalation rule the original never states, and "only the install steps above are manual" is also a new operational claim.
Step 3 runs "sudo cp /etc/billing/tls/current.pem /etc/billing/tls/previous.pem" before the step 4 swap, and Rollback runs "sudo cp .../previous.pem .../current.pem" and then restarts billing-worker.
History is cut to two sentences in a final "## Background" section ("Certs were rotated by hand on each box until 2024..."), and the steps contain no long explanation.
A "Before you start" checklist puts the month-end, VPN and role checks ahead of the steps, the backup is step 3 before the swap, and each numbered step has one action with a linked Rollback section.
